summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 26/27 campaign with high hopes for promotion, having recently welcomed some fantastic new signings and one returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers put in a solid performance against St Helens last time out, though they came up short as their opponents made the most of their chances. With three brand new kits and an exciting squad taking shape, the club is also on the lookout for sponsorship partners ahead of what promises to be an exciting season.
